text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain pledges support to the humanitarian work carried out by the United Nations Relief Works Agency.
- Move to make Bahrain regional training centre.
- U.S. reaffirms commitment to Bahrain and other Gulf Arab states, a top U.S. defence official said.
- Growing losses and financial difficulties are forcing the government to liquidate the Vehicles Insurance Fund.
- Bahrain rejects Amnesty International report on trial of coup suspects.
- Bahraini Saudi Bank to pay 1.8 million dinar dividend to shareholders for 1996.
- New steps to develop Bahrain Stock Exchange.
- Iranian foreign minister to arrive in Bahrain on Wednesday.
